title: Check
description: The request of the command check. A machine adapter is a program that makes and deletes machines at one vendor, such as a cloud. The provisioner, the starter of the provisioner contract, https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/, runs the adapter to make a machine for each dispatch, and to delete the machine once it stops. With check, the adapter shows that its rights at the vendor and its settings work, and makes no machine. The check answer lists the machines the adapter can make with its settings. When the adapter's settings contain more than 64 machines, or none, check fails with kind defect. The command line is `<adapter> check --settings FILE`, where FILE is the path of the adapter's settings, whose content each adapter defines. The adapter reads this request as one JSON document on standard input. On success it writes one JSON answer on standard output, check-answer.schema.json, and exits with status 0. On failure it writes error.schema.json on standard output and exits with status 1. The adapter refuses a request with another version as a failure of kind defect. It ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless the must_understand of the request lists it.

version.description: The request format: 1. The adapter refuses another version, as a failure of kind defect.

must_understand.description: The members of the document that the reader must understand, each as a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) counted from the document, such as /version. List each once, at most 32. A pointer has no line feed, and writes ~ only as ~0 or ~1. Each pointer is to a member that this schema defines. The adapter ignores a member that this schema does not define, unless must_understand lists it. It refuses a request whose must_understand lists a pointer that it does not define, as a failure of kind defect.
